owner_instruction: Do not spend available research time merely waiting for a future Day1 PRE publication. While any priority event is time-blocked, autonomously consume all safe work that is already possible inside the accepted research boundaries.
fixed_policy: Keep the earliest positive PRE opportunity monitored, but waiting must not become the primary activity while other admissible work exists.

During PRE-publication waits, exhaustively screen existing positive 333/333.33m prospective event-level assen lists against accepted frozen historical PRE blocks using exact normalized rider-name equality only; no fuzzy matching.
Resolve official KEIRIN.JP registration identities in advance for every exact-match candidate where positive evidence is available.
Strengthen non-exhaustive candidate sets to exhaustive status whenever the positively observed event-level assen list permits it.

Audit the accepted research evidence inventory for additional already-clean cross-circumference PRE blocks or admissible pairings before concluding that calendar waiting is unavoidable; never mutate the frozen historical HFT scope and never reconstruct PRE after cutoff.
Use the existing positive event queue before expanding it. Expand only when a real coverage/gate deficiency remains after existing admissible work is exhausted.
When a Day1 racecard becomes positively available, immediately preempt lower-priority screening and execute the strict PRE-to-support chain.
Never increment formal support without prospective Day1 PRE membership, official registration identity, contemporaneous official same-race assignment, and provenance PASS.
RESULT, payout, odds, formula fitting, S0 mutation, main/production mutation, guessed race IDs/URLs, and post-cutoff PRE reconstruction remain prohibited.
Owner should only be asked to act at a genuine owner-only boundary; ordinary waiting, screening, identity resolution, and evidence preparation are research-lane work.
reporting_rule: Periodic owner reports must distinguish calendar-blocked work from work that was advanced during the wait, and must end with 今やっていること / 苦戦していること / 解決策 with Japanese glosses for specialist terms.
